title: kith-tui: pending_sc deferred dispatch syncs prev_selected unconditionally
description: After dispatching pending_sc, the code unconditionally sets prev_selected = state.selected_chat. The comment says 'A Chat state change calls load_startup_data which may clamp selected_chat'. But a Message state change does not call load_startup_data and does not clamp selected_chat. Syncing prev_selected after a Message state change means the chat-selection-change reload path (the block at the bottom of the loop) will NOT fire for a selection change that happened during the handle_state_change await. This is correct behavior (the reload already happened for the new selection), but the reason is implicit: handle_state_change for Message type reloads messages if selected_chat changed during the await. A comment explaining why prev_selected is synced for both Chat AND Message state changes would prevent future confusion.
